Services

Our strategy centers on high-performance digital advertising, leveraging Google Ads (Paid Search, YouTube, Display), Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and OTA media such as BNSA & TravelAds. These channels are supported by smart targeting, retargeting, and continuous optimization. Alongside digital ads, we manage e-commerce, branding, social media, and commercial sales to ensure a fully integrated marketing ecosystem that drives measurable revenue growth.

Commercial Partner

Imagine your property running smoother while your sales and bookings grow behind the scenes. We handle every part of sales marketing revenue and reservation support so your hotel or villa can focus fully on the guest experience.

Digital Marketing

Your direct bookings can grow faster than you think. With smart digital moves and targeted online exposure we help your property appear exactly where guests are looking.

Social Media Management

Your story deserves attention. We create social content that makes people stop look and want to learn more about your property.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026. DRAFT: please review before publishing.

This policy explains how Nava Hospio Solution (“we”, “us”) handles personal information collected through www.hospiosolutions.com.

Information we collect

When you use our contact forms, we collect the details you enter: your name, email address and message. Like most websites, we also collect anonymous usage data through Google Analytics, such as pages visited, approximate location, device and browser type.

How we use it

We use form details to reply to your enquiry and to discuss our services. We use analytics data to understand how the website is used and to improve it. We do not sell your personal information.

Service providers

Form submissions are processed by Formspree and delivered to our email. Website analytics are provided by Google Analytics. The website is hosted on Vercel. These providers process data under their own privacy policies.

Cookies

Google Analytics uses cookies to measure traffic. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, or use Google’s opt-out browser add-on.

Retention and your rights

We keep enquiry emails only as long as needed to respond and to maintain business records. You may ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by emailing us.

Accessibility Statement

Last updated: October 2026. DRAFT: please review before publishing.

Nava Hospio Solution wants www.hospiosolutions.com to be usable by everyone, including people who use assistive technology.

What we do

We build the site with semantic HTML, keyboard-friendly navigation, visible focus indicators, text alternatives for meaningful images, labelled form fields, and colour contrast aimed at WCAG 2.1 level AA. The layout adapts to phones, tablets and desktops, and animation respects the reduced-motion setting of your device.

Known limits

We are still improving. Some content, such as older blog posts or third-party property websites we link to, may not fully meet these standards.

Feedback

If you have trouble using any part of this website, email info@hospiosolutions.com and tell us the page and the problem. We will respond and work on a fix.
